limitations: Lexical analysis, not a JavaScript parser: no scope, type, or data-flow analysis.
Aliases are not followed: `const p = "system.credits"; update({[p]: v})` is reported as unresolved-use at the literal, not as a write.
Computed or concatenated paths (`"system." + key`, template literals with substitutions) are not resolved and can be missed (false negatives).
Dynamic dispatch, `Reflect`, `eval`, bracket-notation property writes with non-literal keys, and writes inside generated code are invisible.
Writes performed by other modules, macros, compendium/data scripts, templates (.hbs) or the Foundry core are out of scope; only scripts/ and index.js are scanned.
A payload key (`"system.credits": v`) is treated as write-intent even if the object is never passed to an update call (possible false positive).
A delegated call is reported at the call site; whether the callee behaves correctly is NOT assessed.
Comments are excluded; string contents are kept (so a protected path inside a log message appears as unresolved-use).

Known false negatives that the audit has verified are listed in the artifact's `knownUnobserved` inventory with per-family `coverage`; a family with a present entry is KNOWN_GAPS, and no family is ever `inventoryComplete`.

A bare identifier with a protected name (a local variable, parameter, or destructured binding) is treated as a local binding, not a field write; a write through a destructured or aliased object reference is a false negative.
A payload-key lookalike (for example a type-coercion map `{ "system.credits": "number" }`) is reported as a payload-key write: lexical analysis cannot distinguish it (known false positive).
Regex-literal and template-literal detection is heuristic; a lexing failure degrades to unresolved findings, never to silence.

coverage.statement: This inventory is a LOWER BOUND of recognized write forms. No protected family may be described as completely inventoried; families with a present known-unobserved entry have KNOWN_GAPS.

knownUnobserved.description: ActionEconomyPersistence writes (setFlag) and clears (unsetFlag) the action-economy flag through class constants, not a literal key.
knownUnobserved.reason: The flag key is `this.FLAG_KEY`; lexical analysis does not resolve constants (limitation L1).
knownUnobserved.certificationEffect: The action-economy family has zero recognized direct writers while its authority writes the flag; the family must not be described as completely inventoried.

knownUnobserved.description: InventoryEngine writes weapon/shield activation fields (system.activated, system.active, emitLight and bladeColor flags) outside the configured equipment patterns, and the equipment coordinator's ready-ignite path owns the same fields.
knownUnobserved.reason: The equipmentState family is configured for posture, occupancy and the journal only (limitation L10).
knownUnobserved.certificationEffect: Equipment readiness/activation is not fully inventoried; the family must not be described as completely inventoried.

knownUnobserved.description: InventoryEngine writes system.equipped for equip/unequip of armor and equipment.
knownUnobserved.reason: `system.equipped` is not a configured protected path (limitation L10).
knownUnobserved.certificationEffect: Non-weapon equip state is not inventoried.

knownUnobserved.description: InventoryEngine activation spends shield resources (system.currentSR, system.charges.current) as an absolute value derived from an in-memory read.
knownUnobserved.reason: These resource fields are not configured protected paths (limitation L10).
knownUnobserved.certificationEffect: Shield activation resources are not inventoried; they are a resource write, not only a state write.

knownUnobserved.description: Force Points are written through SchemaAdapters.setForcePointsUpdate, which returns the payload; the callers pass it to ActorEngine.updateActor. The analyzer reports the adapter, not the callers.
knownUnobserved.reason: The write payload is built in another function; no data-flow analysis (limitation L5/L7).
knownUnobserved.certificationEffect: The Force Point direct-writer list is a lower bound; callers via the adapter are invisible by caller.
